evacuationCenters.title: Tundikhel
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Tundikhel is situated in ward no. 3 of Bhimeshwor Municipality. The site is located towards the northeast of Charikot bazar. It has a total area of 10,758 m² and the usable area is 7,970 m². Tundikhel is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal and is situated near to most of the government offices including District Administrative Office, Land Revenue Office, District Survey Office, District Hospital, District Police Office, Armed Police Force, Nepal Army, Bhimeshwor municipal office and others. Health facilities include Samudayik Hospital, Chhorolpa Hospital and Primary Health Centre at around 200 m from the site. Likewise, educational institutions including Tripura Glorious Academy, Shree Darfe Devisthan Basic School, Pashupati Kanya School and Gauri Shankar Campus are located a few hundred metres from the site. Onsite amenities like water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility, Wi-Fi network and trees and vegetation are absent in the area. Currently this open space is used as a sports ground by the community for various activities and sport tournaments.

evacuationCenters.title: Budabhimsen Mandir Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Budabhimsen Mandir Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 5 of Bhimeshwor Municipality. The site is located in the southernmost part of the municipality. It has a total area of 8,091.53 m² and the usable area is 5,235 m². Major critical facilities near the site include Makalbari Health Post, Kiratichhap Sahari Swasthya Kendra, Shree Chetanshil Primary School and the Nepal Army and Nepal Police at a few kilometres distance from the site. Likewise, market at Charikot is located at 4.5 km from the site. Budabhimsen temple and Shivalaya temple are located near to this playground. The moderately populated settlements are located in the eastern and western parts of the site. Currently the site is used as a playground by the community and there are ongoing constructions in the site.

evacuationCenters.title: Bangechaur and Sahid Smriti Park
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: The open space is located within flat surface above Kali Gandaki River valley with an approximate area of 54,511.18 m², with an usable open space area of 23,228.50 m² which can accommodate maximum up to 6,637 people (3.5 m² per person). This site is within 3 Km distance from Nepal Army Barrack and 1.1 Km from Nepal Police. The site is linked by Baglung Kushma Road and includes physical structure and WASH facilities. Furthermore, the area is safe from bank cutting and inundation of river water.

evacuationCenters.title: Birendra Aishwarya Park
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Birendra Aishwarya Park is located on the flat surface of Baglung Bazar with a total area of 3,387.07 m², with an usable open space area of 2,678.96 m². This site is relatively small but it can hold maximum upto 765 people (3.5 m² per person). Nepal Army, Nepal Police and Helipad are within the distance of 1 Km. It is located in the market are buildings, but the space is full of trees and vegetation. It is connected with Pokhara Jomsom road.

evacuationCenters.title: Kharidhunga Football Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Kharidhunga Football Ground is situated in ward no. 9 of Bhimeshwor Municipality. The site is located in the western part of the municipality. The total area of the site is 7,399.95 m² and the usable area is 4,930 m². Major critical facilities near the site include Kharidhunga Sahari Swasthya Kendra, Nepal Army and Kharidhunga Police Station at a few hundred metres from the site. Similarly, Surke Secondary School is at 400 m and helipad is located around 300 m from the site. The site also has a facility of drinking water. This football ground was recently extended to a sports ground and is located close to Kharidhunga market.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhitteri Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Bhitteri ground is situated in ward no. 8 of Bhimeshwor Municipality. The site is located 16 km north-west of Charikot bazar. It has an approximate area of 4,000 m² and the entire area is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of Government of Nepal. It is surrounded by trees. Onsite amenities like water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility and Wi-Fi network are not available in this area. Currently this open space is in the construction phase. The municipality has plans and programs to develop this location further into a proper playground for sports and leisure activities.

evacuationCenters.title: Kalinchowk Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Kalinchowk Secondary School is situated in ward no. 3 of Bhimeshwor Municipality. The site is located in the southern part of Charikot bazar. The total area of the site is 4,431 m² and the usable area is 4,100 m². The site is under the ownership of the school. The site is easily accessible, and Nepal Army and Satdobato Police Post are located at around 600 m from the site. Similarly, health facilities like Samudayik Hospital and Chhorolpa Hospital are located nearby the school. The open space is within the school premises and has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Deurali Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Deurali Ground is situated in ward no. 4 of Chautara Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located at a distance of 2.5 km east of Chautara bazar. It has a total area of 7,824.98 m² out of which the total usable area is 6,205 m². The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Deurali Ground is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 5-metre-wide gravel road. District hospital is located at a distance of 3.7 km from the site and the nearest settlements include Deurali in the north, Dandapari in the south and Kamikhet in the west of the site. Currently this open space is used as a playground by the community for various sports activities and tournaments.

evacuationCenters.title: Bal Mandir
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: This open space is adjacent to the Dhaulagiri multiple campus. It has an approximate area of 1,902.4 m², with an usable open space area of 1,008.05 m². The small open space includes several office buildings and can accommodate approximately 228 people.

evacuationCenters.title: Bal Uddhan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: This site has an area of 8,358.7 m², with an usable open space area of 7,101.53 m² and can hold up to 2,029 people. The site is in near to Baglung Kalika temple, and the security forces and community forest area.

evacuationCenters.title: Tundikhel
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Tundikhel is situated in ward no. 5 of Chautara Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located in the north western part of Chautara bazar. It has a total area of 10,952.68 m² out of which the total usable area is 9,355 m². The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Tundikhel is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 7-metre-wide gravel road. Major government offices including the municipal office, District Administration Office and District Coordination Committee are located within 100 m from the site. Similarly, District Hospital and District Police Office are located at a distance of 300 m from the site. Tundikhel was used for temporary settlement and health camp during the 2015 earthquakes. Currently the site is used as a playground by the community for various sports activities and tournaments.

evacuationCenters.title: Rampure Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Rampure Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 6 of Chautara, Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located at a distance of 4 km from Chautara bazar. It has a total area of 7,528.68 m² out of which the total usable area is 5,920 m². The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Rampure Khel Maidan is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 5-metre-wide gravel road. Health facilities include Pipaldanda Health Post, Ayurved Health Centre and Sanosiruwari Health Post at a distance of around 2 km from the site. Similarly, the nearest educational institutions are Siddhi Ganesh Higher Secondary School and Janata Basic School. Pipaldanda is the nearest settlement located within 500 m from the site. Rampure Khel Maidan is currently used as a sports ground by the community.

evacuationCenters.title: Gyan Mandir Namuna Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Gyan Mandir Namuna Secondary School is situated in ward no. 7 of Chautara Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located at a distance of 2 km west of Irkhu bazar and 2 km south of Chautara bazar. The school ground has a total area of 4,689.66 m² out of which the total usable area is 3,430 m². This site is under the ownership of the school and is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 4.5-metre-wide road. Gyan Mandir Namuna Higher Secondary School is located near the site. The nearest settlement, Melchaur is nearby the site. The site is within the school premises and has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Madkeno Football Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Madkeno Football Ground is situated in ward no. 11 of Chautara Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located at a distance of 12 km south of Chautara bazar. It has a total area of 11,819.53 m² and the total usable area is 7,490 m². The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Madkeno Football Ground is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 5-metre-wide gravel road. Bachala Devi Pre-Primary School and Gyanjyoti Primary School are the nearest educational institutions from the site. Gairithok and Sangachowk are the nearest settlements located within 1 km from the site. It is a recently constructed football ground; however, the ground may not be usable during the monsoon season.

evacuationCenters.title: Adarsha Azad Higher Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Adarsha Azad Higher Secondary School is located towards south-east of the densely populated Bhaktapur city. It extends to an area of 2,171.66 m² out of which 1,910 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for medical assistance during a disaster. The updated survey shows no significant change in the usable area of the site, as there were no new structures in the area. The site is located on school grounds and has a proper WASH facility that can be used during an emergency.

evacuationCenters.title: Ranitar Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Ranitar Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 14 of Chautara Sangachowkgadhi Municipality. It is located at a relatively higher elevation than that of Ranitar settlement. It has a total area of 10,165.76 m² out of which the total usable area is 6,025 m². The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Ranitar Khel Maidan is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a recently constructed 4-metre-wide road. Seti Devi Primary School is in close proximity to the site. Currently this site is used as a sports ground and can also be used as a helipad during an emergency.

evacuationCenters.title: Rangasala
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Rangasala is situated in ward no. 6 of Gorkha Municipality. It is located at Haramtari, the major market area of this municipality. It has a total area of 6,894.539 m² out of which the total usable area is 4,740 m². This site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Rangasala is easily accessible throughout the year. Health facilities near Rangasala include District Hospital, Sansthagat Clinic and Marie Stopes Centre. Similarly, Shakti Secondary School with well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility is located near the site. District Police and Army Helipad site is also located within a few hundred metres from Rangasala. This site was used as settlement area by the displaced people of nearby communities during the 2015 earthquakes. Currently, the site is used as a sports ground by the community and various cultural and religious programs, musical events and other recreational activities are conducted in this site.

evacuationCenters.title: Barahi Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Aamchaur
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Aamchaur is situated in ward no. 8 of Gorkha Municipality. It is located at 4.5 km south of Gorkha bazar. It has a total area of 4,864.955 m² out of which the total usable area is 4,360 m². This site is also called as Aase Aahal Khel Maidan and is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Aamchaur is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 3.5-metre-wide road. It is surrounded by trees in all sides. Major critical facilities near the site are Raniswara Health Post and Suryodaya Primary School. The nearest helipad is available at Rangasala which is 4.5 km north of the site. Similarly, Kunabari towards the east and Khamarebesi towards the west are the nearest settlements from the site. This open space is currently used as sports ground by the community.

evacuationCenters.title: Shikhar Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Shikhar Ground is situated in ward no. 9 of Gorkha Municipality. It is located at 1.5 km southeast of Laxmi bazar. It has a total area of 9,163.558 m² out of which the total usable area is 6,850 m². This site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. Shikhar Ground is connected to a seasonal earthen road. Jokhetar in the north and Sikhar in the west are the nearby settlements from this site. Major critical facilities include Laxmibazar Sahari Swasthya Kendra, Laxmi Samudayik Shikshya Sadan and Laxmibazar Police Station within few hundred metres from the site. Similarly, the site itself can be used as helipad during an emergency. This open space is currently used as a football ground by the community.

evacuationCenters.title: Mahadevtari Picnic Spot
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Mahadevtari Picnic Spot is situated in ward no. 10 of Gorkha Municipality. The site is one of the major picnic spots and tourist destinations located nearby Gorkha bazar. It has a total area of 8,387.42 m² out of which the total usable area is 7,205 m². The site is easily accessible throughout the year as it is connected to a 6-metre-wide gravel road. Major critical facilities include Chebetar Sahari Swasthya Kendra, Suryodaya Bal Bikas and Barha Kilo Police Station located at a few hundred metres from the site. Similarly, the nearest helipad is located at Laxmibazar Army Barrack which is around 8 km from the site. Chebetar towards the north, Okhale towards the east and Barhakilo and Terhakilo towards the south are the nearest settlements from this picnic spot. The site also has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Gorakhkali Khelkud Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Gorakhkali Khelkud Maidan is situated in ward no. 13 of Gorkha Municipality. This site is the main football ground of Gorkha district located nearby Laxmi Bazar. It has a total area of 9,666.3 m² and the entire area is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Government of Nepal. This site is easily accessible in all seasons throughout the year. Major critical facilities include Abukhaireni Health Post, Ram Shah Pre-Primary School and Majhuwa Police Station located a few hundred metres from the site. Similarly, the site itself can be used as a helipad during an emergency. Majhuwa towards the west and Phedi bazar towards the north are the nearest settlements from this ground. This site was also used as a logistic hub and distribution centre by different humanitarian agencies during the 2015 earthquakes. Football tournaments of different levels (ward, municipal and district) are conducted every year in this open space.

evacuationCenters.title: Bagbani
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Chebetar Barbare Chaur
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Chebetar Barbare Chaur is a playground located in the eastern side of Marsyangdhi river in ward no. 10 of Gorkha Municipality. The total area of the ground is 6,505 m² out of which the usable flat area is 3,970 m². This is a recently built large playground equipped with necessary facilities like drinking water, toilet and changing room for the athletes. It is connected to a 7-metre-wide all season gravel road and about 300 m away from the settlement. Gorkha municipality and All Nepal Football Association (ANFA) are planning to develop the site as a district level sports ground as per the national standards. Chebetar Barbare Chaur can be used as a temporary camping site, a storage and a distribution hub during an emergency. However, due to its location nearby the river, it is vulnerable to the risk of flood during the monsoon season.

evacuationCenters.title: Basundhara/Komagana Park
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Gorkha Multiple Campus
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Gorkha Multiple Campus is the oldest campus in Gorkha district. It covers a large area with campus buildings and playgrounds within its premises. The campus also has a pond in the western side. It has a total area of 15,000 m² out of which the usable area is 4,450 m². There are multiple playgrounds but currently covered by grass. The boundary of the campus is fenced and has the availability of water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility. The campus is planning to remove the vegetation and maintain the ground areas. Similarly, the campus also has plans for developing a part of the site as an herbal garden. The site can be used as a warehouse and a distribution centre during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Exhibition Centre
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Tara Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description:
"Shree Tara Secondary School is a government school situated in ward no. 10 of Gorkha Municipality. The school has an open playground and is connected to all season gravel road. There are new buildings under construction within the school premises. The school also has few trees and vegetation in its periphery. The total area of the school ground is 7,680 m² out of which the usable flat area is 3,180 m² and can accommodate 908 people during a disaster.
"

evacuationCenters.title: Mahendra Madhyamik Vidhyalaya
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Mahendra Secondary School is a popular government school located at the western edge of Daskilo Bazar, ward no. 12 of Gorkha Municipality. This school is surrounded by agriculture lands. The school is about 60 m north of Abukhaireni-Gorkha road. It has a large area of 9,228 m² out of which 6,735 m² is the usable flat area and can accommodate 1,924 people during an emergency.

evacuationCenters.title: Taple Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Taple Khel Maidan is situated at ward no. 1 of Gorkha Municipality. It is located next to Taple health post. The site is connected to all season earthen road and is surrounded by trees on western and northern sides. The total area of the ground is 6,950 m² out of which the usable flat area is 3,190 m² which can accommodate 911 people during an emergency. The area is being developed as a major playground at ward no. 1 by the local government with other infrastructures such as bleachers in the site.

evacuationCenters.title: Rajetar Khelkud Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Rajetar Khel Maidan is situated at Rajetar, ward no. 3 of Gorkha Municipality. It is connected to a seasonal earthen road. The ground is close to the settlement and 300 m away from Magar community building. The total area of the ground is 4,140 m² out of which the usable flat area is 3,240 m² and can accommodate 925 people during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Amar Singh Ground/School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Institute of Forestry
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Indra Rajha Laxmi Higher Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Institute of Engineering, WRC
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Chinese Camp
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Chinese Camp is situated in ward no. 2 of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality. Tatopani, a major trade route linking China to Nepal is located near the site. It has a total area of 3,646.51 m² and the total usable area is 1,420 m². This camp is connected to a gravel road. A small market at Thuman, a local health post, border police force and border army are located a few hundred metres from the site. Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility is available in the site. This camp is currently used by the Chinese people for construction of a hydropower. According to the ward chairperson, the construction work is expected to complete by the end of 2020. All the existing temporary buildings will be removed after construction and the open space in the area will be handed to the local community.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhedi Farm
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Briddim Dong Chokla Kang
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Briddim Dong Chokla Kang is situated in ward no. 3 of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality. This site is located in the Langtang National Park region. The site has a total area of 3,985.21 m² and the total usable area is 3,205 m². Health facility is located at around 300 m from the site. It is connected to an earthen road. According to a local informant, the site was donated to the community Gumba for communal purposes.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhadrakali Higher Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Syamewangfel School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Syamewangfel School is situated in ward no. 5 of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality. The site is located at Syafru Besi. It has a total area of 9,317.91 m² and the total usable area is 1,675 m². This open space is within the school premises and is surrounded by school buildings, vegetation and agricultural lands. The school is connected to an earthen road which links to a blacktopped road a few hundred metres from the school. Health facility is at around 500 m from the school. Market at Syafrubesi and a local police station are located at a few hundred metres from the site. This school has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility and can be a suitable site to use it during an emergency.

evacuationCenters.title: Sanskrit Madhyamik Vidhyalaya
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 6 of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality. The site is located at the district headquarter, Dhunche. It has a total area of 3,633.88 m² and the total usable area of 1,800 m². This open space is surrounded by the Army Barrack, District Administration Office, and other government offices. District Health Post is located at 250 m from the site. Similarly, District Police Post is located near the site. This playground has water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility and helipad is in the nearby Army Barrack. This playground is frequently used by local schools and communities for sports activities. According to a local informant, this playground was used for humanitarian purpose during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Baal Mandir (Shabha Hall)
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Baal Mandir (Shabha Hall) is situated in ward no. 6 of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality. The site is located at the district headquarter, Dhunche. It has a total area of 2,682.29 m² and the total usable area is 1,550 m². This open space is surrounded by dense settlements. District Health Post, District Police and Army Camp are located at around 200 m from the site. It is connected to a blacktopped road. The site has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility. Various community functions such as marriage and Bratabanda are conducted in this site. Helipad is available in the Army Barrack near the site. This open space was also used for humanitarian purpose during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Basu School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Basu School is located in the eastern side of Bhaktapur Durbar Square. It extends to an area of 2,625.05 m² out of which 1,475 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for humanitarian camp during a disaster. The updated survey shows the reduction of usable area for humanitarian camp due to the addition of two buildings, one in the north of the garden and another in the south-west part of the school. There is also ongoing construction of a building in the south of the school gate. The identified open space is within the school premises and has a proper WASH facility that can strengthen camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Jaisi Chaur Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Dumre Danda Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Dumre Danda Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 2 of Neelakantha Municipality. It has a total area of 7,761.35 m² and the usable area is 4,040 m². This open space is accessible through an earthen road. Critical facilities such as hospitals, educational infrastructures, security and market are located at around 7 km from the site.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhaktapur Bahumukhi Campus
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Bhaktapur Bahumukhi Campus is located south of the main road leading to Bhaktapur city. It extends to an area of 25,970.81 m² out of which 22,110 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for settlement/camp during a disaster. The updated survey shows the reduced usable area due to the addition of three recent constructions following the demolition of an old building. The identified open space is within the school premises and has a proper WASH facility that can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Gauri Shankar Khel Maidan and Gauri Shankar Madhyamik Vidhyalaya
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Designated emergency open space for tented shelter, WASH distribution, and triage.

evacuationCenters.title: Khulla Manch
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Khulla Manch is situated in ward no. 3 of Neelakantha Municipality. The site is located in the district headquarter, Dhading Besi. It has a total area of 8,115.83 m² and the usable area is 7,535 m². This open space is near to Nepal Army Barrack, District Administration Office and other government offices. It is easily accessible via blacktopped road. Various district and school level sports activities are conducted in this site. Dhading District Hospital is located at a few kilometres distance from the site. Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility is also available in the site. A helipad zone is located in the nearby Army Barrack. According to a local informant, this open space was extensively used as temporary shelter during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Alchhi Danda Khel Maidan
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Alchhi Danda Khel Maidan is situated in ward no. 4 of Neelakantha Municipality. The site is located at around 1 km south of Dhading Besi. It has a total area of 8,666 m² and the entire area is usable for humanitarian purposes. This open space is surrounded by a community forest. It is connected to an earthen road. Various sports activities are conducted in this open space. It also has a well-managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster. According to a local informant, this open space was extensively used as temporary shelter during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Sunaula Bazar Tundikhel
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Sunaula Bazar Tundikhel is situated in ward no. 6 of Neelakantha Municipality. The site is located towards the south-east of the municipality. It has a total area of 10,188.8 m² and the usable area is 10,185 m². This site is easily accessible through a blacktopped road. Local police station and a market are located near the site. It has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster. This site was also used for temporary shelter during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Deurali Secondary School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Deurali Secondary School is situated in ward no. 8 of Neelakantha Municipality. The site is located towards the south-west of the municipality. The school ground has a total area of 5,031.59 m² and the total usable area is 2,990 m². This school is connected to an earthen road. Dhading District Hospital is located at a few kilometres distance from the site. The school also has a well managed water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facility which can strengthen the camp management during a disaster. This school ground was also used for temporary shelter during the 2015 earthquakes.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Bhaktapur Durbar Square is centrally located in Bhaktapur and included in the UNESCO World Heritage list. It extends to an area of 5,936.30 m² out of which 5,200 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Department of Archaeology. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable as a distribution area during a disaster. Bhaktapur Durbar Square was highly affected by the Gorkha earthquake in 2015, and numerous structures are still under reconstruction. For renovation purposes, many areas of the site are being used to store construction materials, and people are not allowed to enter those specific areas of the site. This has reduced the usable area temporarily.

evacuationCenters.title: Bhelukhel
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Bhelukhel is located in the densely populated area of Bhaktapur city, near the manure production site in Bhaktapur. It extends to an area of 4,659.93 m² out of which 4,150 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the municipality of Bhaktapur. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for logistical purposes during a disaster. The updated survey shows the addition of one building in the southern part and a temple in the south-east of the identified open space, on the way to Jagati. A few parts of the site have been used to store the construction materials. These added structures have reduced the usable area of the site.

evacuationCenters.title: Birendra Sainik School
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Birendra Sainik School is located along the main road leading to Bhaktapur city. It extends to an area of 67,089.78 m² out of which 56,100 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Nepal Army and the Ministry of Defence. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for multiple purposes, including civil–military coordination centre, warehouse, medical assistance, helipad, humanitarian coordination, vulnerable population assistance, telecommunications and for accessing potable water during a disaster. The updated survey shows the addition of two buildings and two restrooms that have reduced the usable area of the site. The area is located within the school premises and has a well-managed WASH facility, which is a key factor for the people residing here during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Datattraya
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Datattraya Square is located in Bhaktapur district. It extends to an area of 1,937.70 m² out of which 1,735 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of Guthi Sansthan. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for medical assistance during a disaster. The updated survey shows no major changes in the site besides one electrical pole added in the site. The usable area has not been reduced and can be utilized during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Khwopa College
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Khwopa College is located in the eastern part of Bhaktapur Durbar Square. It extends to an area of 26,692.29 m² out of which 22,650 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the municipality of Bhaktapur. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for settlement/camp during a disaster. The updated survey shows the addition of a few new structures including college buildings and facilities that have significantly reduced the usable open-space area. However, proper WASH facilities available within this site will strengthen the camp management during an emergency.

evacuationCenters.title: Khwopa Engineering College
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Khwopa Engineering College is located in the eastern side of Bhaktapur Durbar Square. It extends to an area of 11,916.01 m² out of which 7,235 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the municipality of Bhaktapur. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for settlement/camp during a disaster. As per the updated survey, the recently built structures in the site have significantly reduced the usable area. Nevertheless, the addition of few electrical poles can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.

evacuationCenters.title: Kwathandu

evacuationCenters.description: Kwathandu is situated in the densely populated area of Bhaktapur. It extends to an area of 1,531.74 m² out of which 1,445 m² is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of Guthi Sansthan. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for medical assistance during a disaster. The updated survey concluded that there were no significant changes in the area and the open space can be utilized for medical assistance during a crisis.

evacuationCenters.title: Maheshwori Football Ground
evacuationCenters.managedBy: District Disaster Management Committee / IOM
evacuationCenters.description: Maheshwori Football Ground is located at the south-east of densely populated Bhaktapur city. It extends to an area of 8,354 m² and the entire area is found to be usable. The site is under the ownership of the Bhaktapur District Sports Development Committee. The previous study suggested the site to be suitable for settlement/camp during a disaster. The updated survey shows no major changes in the usable area of the open space. The site has a well-managed WASH facility that can strengthen the camp management during a disaster.
